risk.rationale: All high-severity hypotheses for prof.kaya@aegean.edu are rejected by the verified critics: impossible travel fails because the TR hit is a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail token (not the person) and the PT sign-ins sit on university VPN vpn-edge-02 from known device LT-3104; the 193.140.10.21 failures are shared-egress background noise (201 MFA completions in 30 days), not a spray; and both VPN KEV claims are neutralized (vpn-edge-02 patched; vpn-edge-01 never carried this account). What remains is F2: one CONFIRMED sign-in from Turkcell TR outside the account baseline (T1078.004). It is a single, non-interactive event, so it is not a confirmed account-takeover chain (contain) and is not fully explained away as benign (the TR ASN for a mail-sync token is not yet accounted for). It does not rise to conflicting/insufficient evidence (escalate). It is best classed as a weak unexplained signal: monitor, anchored on confirmed F2 with F4 establishing the PT baseline that makes TR anomalous.
